name: Gesang Alisjahbana
source: Even though he is not from Overture, Gesang chose to lend his power to the proletariat’s struggle against oppression. He hopes the revolution will eventually bring independence to his own homeland, an Overturian colony in the east—a far away land from which magic comes.
